text:
Before: 1 slice of wholemeal toast (~35 g, ~90 kcal), 2 fried eggs (~100 g, ~180 kcal), a cup of coffee with milk (~250 ml, ~60 kcal), apple juice (~200 ml), margarine (~10 g, ~70 kcal), sugar stick (~3 g, ~12 kcal), and peanut butter (~11 g, ~65 kcal).

After: the toast and eggs are eaten and the coffee is finished. The juice is mostly untouched, perhaps 30 ml consumed (~14 kcal). The peanut butter is opened and about half used (~5 g, ~30 kcal). The margarine is gone, so assume it was used (~70 kcal). The sugar stick is also gone, so assume it was used (~12 kcal).

Total energy: 90 + 180 + 60 + 14 + 30 + 70 + 12 = 456 kcal.
Total mass: 35 + 100 + 250 + 30 + 5 + 10 + 3 = 433 g.
